DLC2304:3:t_3:32.en:

review.context: Kaname is pursued by mercenaries and saved by Sousuke in the Bonta-kun suit. Their later reconciliation uses the suit to speak frankly. Combat events show the mass-production Bonta army and allied reinforcements.
decisions: Bonta-kun vocalizations are romanized; the supplied parenthetical translations remain explicit speech content.
The mass-production Bonta army uses the robot token; the speaking suit uses the pilot token.
Alto's interrupted Bonta-kun address and Hibiki's almost-spoken Sousuke name preserve the disguise gag.
Kaname's plea and Hibiki's assignment keep the direction of their requests explicit.
uncertainties: Kocher renders the camping-pot word in the mercenary's deliberate wrong mascot guess; provisional pending glossary normalization.
